name: SporkMoney
description: Personal finance app for tracking spending, setting budget goals, and seeing what I can afford. Plaid integration for syncing accounts, plus projection math for daily allowance, savings runway, and emergency-fund timelines.

name: Streamour
description: Self-hosted streaming server that converts MKV to HLS for phone and desktop. Cookie auth, middleware-protected routes, and partial content delivery for seeking on mobile.
